hero.title: Personal Investment Diary
hero.subtitle: A personal project built for individual investment management

intro.title: Project Introduction
intro.content: This is a personally developed investment diary system, specifically designed for recording personal investment decisions, transaction records, and market insights. As a personal project, it combines practical investment needs with modern development technologies to provide a simple yet powerful tool.

motivation.title: Development Motivation
motivation.paragraph1: Throughout my investment journey, I discovered that systematically recording trading decisions and reflections is crucial for investment growth. While there are many investment management tools on the market, most are overly complex or lack personalized features.
motivation.paragraph2: Therefore, I decided to develop an investment diary system that meets my personal needs—one that can record trading decisions, track investment performance, and provide timely reminders to help myself continuously learn and improve on the investment path.

features.title: Main Features
features.subtitle: Features tailored for personal investment management

diary.title: Investment Diary
diary.description: Write detailed investment diaries using Markdown syntax, documenting trading reasons, market analysis, and personal reflections to build a complete record of investment decisions.

calendar.title: Calendar View
calendar.description: Display all investment activities in a calendar format, intuitively view daily trades, diaries, and reminders, and quickly locate investment records for specific dates.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Browse all investment records in chronological order, discover investment patterns and decision changes from the timeline, and review your investment journey.

stocks.title: Stock Management
stocks.description: Track stock holdings, calculate average costs, and use the FIFO (First-In-First-Out) method to accurately calculate profit and loss, keeping track of investment performance.

alerts.title: Alert System
alerts.description: Set time-triggered personal reminders to ensure you never miss important trading opportunities or market events.

discipline.title: Trading Discipline
discipline.description: Track trading frequency and discipline, set personal trading goals, and help maintain a stable investment strategy.

security.title: Data Security
security.description: Use JWT authentication and bcrypt password encryption to ensure the privacy and security of your personal investment data.

personal.title: Personal Project Features
personal.content: As a personal project, the system focuses on practicality rather than commercialization. No ads, no data collection, no unnecessary features—only pure investment management tools. All features are developed based on actual investment needs, with continuous optimization and improvement.
